parsed.draft_response:
Hi there—sorry you’re running into this again. I understand this is urgent and impacting your team.

To get this fixed as quickly as possible, we’ll need a few details since the ticket doesn’t include any specifics about what’s failing:
1) What exact feature/workflow is broken (e.g., login, exporting, API actions, specific screen)?
2) What does “the same thing as last time” refer to—can you share a link to the prior ticket/incident, or the last error you saw?
3) Any error message text (and where it appears) plus a screenshot if you have one.
4) When it started and whether it’s happening continuously right now.
5) Your environment and version (prod vs staging) and your browser/OS (or app version).
6) Whether it affects everyone or a specific account/team, and any steps to reproduce.

Once you reply with the above, we’ll route this to engineering for investigation and follow up with next steps.
promised_actions: Route the issue to engineering once the missing details are provided
Follow up with next steps after review
safety_notes: Avoid claiming a refund, confirmed root cause, or resolution
Acknowledge escalation/urgency without promising an SLA or immediate fix
